title: Bot/headless client harness
description: A headless client library for writing bots and automated players. Connects via WebSocket, receives state, submits moves programmatically. No rendering. Use cases: AI research, automated testing, tournament bots, load testing the server. Should be a thin Rust library (and/or Python wrapper) over the existing WebSocket protocol.
close_reason: BaizeClient Python class: WebSocket connect, hello/welcome handshake, state_sync receipt, move submission, token reconnection. Optional websocket-client dep. 9 tests.
